definitions.explanation: A hard solid piece of mineral matter.
Used in compounds to refer to precious stones.

examples.japanese: {道|みち}に{大|おお}きな{石|いし}がある。
examples.english: There's a big rock on the road.

examples.japanese: {石|いし}の{上|うえ}にも{三年|さんねん}。
examples.english: Persistence pays off. (Lit: Even on a stone, three years)
examples.notes: Proverb meaning patience leads to success

notes:
{石|いし} means 'stone' or 'rock.'

Counter: {個|こ} (general counter)

Common compounds:
- {石|いし}{橋|ばし}: stone bridge
- {宝石|ほうせき}: jewel, gem
- {岩石|がんせき}: rock, stone (more formal/scientific)
- {石|いし}{段|だん}: stone steps

Proverb: {石|いし}の{上|うえ}にも{三年|さんねん} - literally 'three years on a stone,' meaning that perseverance will eventually bring results.
